finding: Two capture-off references proved the corrected window-relative pointer coordinates (the X window origin was y=50). The measured mouse attempt waited approximately 15 s in xdotool mousemove --sync at the already-selected position. Watchdog cleanup preceded the click; the one raw discrepancy is an invalid fault fixture, not a qualified mouse failure. The live injector omits mousemove --sync, and fault ordering now rejects capture ending before pointer arrival.
